Corporate Overview

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online  marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands
. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.
Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven  matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.
 They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.
Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.
We believe in:
The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

Job Category

As a key member of the Strategic Marketing & Analytics team, you will be responsible for data-driven insights that enable QuinStreets Marketing and Media teams to maximize profitability while developing customer relationships. You will gather, organize, and aggregate complex sets of data in order to produce meaningful business insight in areas such as ad network optimization, ad merchandising, marketing performance, quality monitoring, partner development, product testing, and more. You will also communicate your insights and findings to various members of our Client, Media, Analytics, and Executive teams.

Responsibilities

Work closely with media and client managers to understand business opportunities for media, client and market growth.
Actively mine data to develop actionable insights from our proprietary datasets using various statistical techniques.
Evaluate strategies and forecast their expected impact to the key performance indicators.
Support analysis and monitoring of business metrics and trends.
Key liaison between business and technical teams in managing day to day data analytics.
Lead a small team of analysts, setting longer-term goals and ensuring short-term operational efficiency.

Requirements

Record of high academic achievement with a BS degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Math/Science, or otherwise proven background in business/analytics. MS preferred, Bonus points for statistics.
8+ years of work experience in data analytics/science.
Strong understanding of statistical methods used in to elicit insights from data.
Strong analytical mindset with a drive toward actionable insights from data.
Deep interest in online marketing and media industry. Industry experience a plus.
High internal motivation with ability to understand the full stack of product development.
Willingness to initiate and own research, exploration, and analysis from start to finish for any business problem.
Good interpersonal skills and ability to remain focused-yet-flexible in a fast-paced internet company environment.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Tableau and SQL.
Familiarity with Python (preferred) or R programming to the level necessary to perform ad-hoc analysis.
Experience managing a small team

jobs.description:
About BITE

Building Impa
ct Through Eaters (BITE) is a nonprofit working to make climate-smart food choices the norm. BITE equips the people and institutions that shape food culture with the tools to make climate-smart choices the easy, appealing, and profitable ones, using narrative and behavioral design. Our methods have consistently proven that when food environments and communications are designed differently, eaters choose differently — without coercion, lectures, or lost revenue.

About our client’s Insights to Action project

The Insights to Action project is part two of BITE's sustainability engagement with a large theme park (client) in Southern California. BITE is leading three-phases of research (details below) co-developed with the Culinary Institute of America including a pilot to test and measure the impact of menu and choice architecture interventions.

The Role

The Data Analyst is the embedded data lead for the Insights to Action project working on-site with the client sustainability team (80%) and remotely with the BITE team (20%). The Data Analyst collaborates closely with culinary professionals, BITE researchers, and external data partners to design instruments, collect data, and translate the findings into clear, actionable insights that inform how the program is designed and how best to scale. This role is for a fixed, 11-month term and we do not anticipate further renewal at this time.

Core Responsibilities

Phase 1 | Chef Change Management Assessment

Co-design and program mobile-friendly survey instruments
used to assess readiness, motivation, and barriers across culinary and front-of-house teams
Recommend a sampling approach
calibrated to the chosen scope of culinary roles and dining locations
Coordinate fielding
logistics on-site, including outreach, reminders, and response tracking to hit target response rates
Lead the quantitative analysis
of survey responses and validate survey findings with previously-conducted qualitative interviews

Phase 2 | Custom Chef Engagement & Certification Program

Design and analyze short pre/post reflection instruments
(2-3 questions, mobile-friendly) embedded in each chef engagement module
Track proposed menu change submissions and synthesize
patterns across hero dishes, sustainability elements, choice architecture interventions, and staff engagement
Manage handoff of recipe inputs to major emissions database (HowGood) for sustainability analysis
and concepts to food and beverage market research firm (Datassential) for consumer testing
Integrate all outputs back into program decisions

Phase 3 | Test & Learn: Single-Site Pilot & Impact Measurement

Lead the day-to-day execution of the impact measurement plan
during the 4-8 week single-site pilot, working hand-in-hand with the client team
Coordinate with culinary, marketing, and front-of-house teams to ensure interventions (menu language, signage, choice architecture) are implemented consistently
and that data is captured cleanly and consistently
Serve as the primary point of contact
for data questions during the pilot
Capture and quality-check
baseline and pilot data, flagging anomalies in real time
Analyze data to measure changes
in sales and menu mix, guest satisfaction indicators, site-specific kg CO 2 e using HowGood, and chef satisfaction and engagement
Build and maintain a dashboard
and summary report that provides a clear, near-real-time view of tracked metrics
Translate findings into clear, actionable insights for the final deliverable
and for a BITE case study

Cross-Phase | Test & Learn: Single-Site Pilot & Impact Measurement

Serve as the BITE team’s on-site lead for pilot data collection and analysis
Recommend and configure data collection tools
(mobile-friendly surveys, POS data extracts) appropriate to the on-site environment, and maintain clear data documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis workflows
Conduct regular check-ins
with BITE researchers and the Director of Programs to align on methodology, share progress, and surface challenges early
Identify gaps
in data collection or analysis processes and propose practical, field-tested solutions
Document lessons learned
to inform impact measurement design for future BITE engagements and scaling to additional sites
Support client’s evaluation of sustainability work contracted with other partner organizations, applying consistent data and measurement standards across their portfolio

Minimum Requirements

2–4 years of behavioral science experience
in quantitative research, data analysis, or applied research, ideally within nonprofit, hospitality, foodservice, sustainable food systems or consumer behavior settings
Demonstrated experience designing and fielding mobile-friendly surveys in Qualtrics
, including sampling strategy, fielding logistics, and response-rate management a plus
Proficiency in statistical methods (descriptive statistics, regression, ANOVA) and data visualization, analysis, and interpretation using R Programming
to measure and validate intervention impact (Python also accepted)
Detail-oriented data analysis and documentation, with experience creating reproducible analysis workflows
Ability to translate
quantitative findings into recommendations for program design and scaling decisions across technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Experience

Familiarity with Scope 3
emissions accounting strategies, ideally in Food & Beverage or Agriculture sector
Building and maintaining dashboards
or other reporting tools that synthesize multiple data streams into clear, actionable updates
Quality-checking and cleaning foodservice data
such as point-of-sale, sales/menu mix, and other operational data

Work Culture Requirements

Ability to work independently and adaptively
in a fast-paced, embedded on-site role, managing multiple concurrent project phases and timelines
A growth mindset
, comfortable with constantly evolving projects and client requirements
Easily operates in a dual-stakeholder
environment, managing responsibilities and communication across both BITE and the client

Why BITE?

We work with the people who shape what we eat – the largest, most influential foodservice operators – to shift perceptions and make climate-smart food choices the norm. You’ll be working with a major brand on an exciting project at the edge of food culture, behavioral science, and climate action. BITE is small enough that your voice shapes the work and established enough that the work has reach.

Benefits

responses to: jobs@walkoflifecoaching.com

This role requires being on-site in Anaheim, CA a minimum of 2 days per week. Are you able to relocate to the Anaheim area at your own expense if selected, without relocation cost assistance from BITE or the client?

Job Description

The Data Analyst 3 will be a senior member of the Supply Chain Intelligence (SCI) team, owning the delivery of data and insights for Nordstrom's Distribution Center and warehouse operations. The Data Analyst 3 will provide ongoing data support, performance analysis, and storytelling, which will lead to value creation and enable the next cycle of growth within Nordstrom — supporting reliable, accurate reporting and data pipeline integrity across inbound, outbound, inventory, and labor operations to help DCs run efficiently and serve customers and stores across the Nordstrom businesses.

A day in the life…

Operate as an insight partner to Distribution Center and Supply Chain leadership, not just a data provider — translating reliable, well-governed data into diagnosis, root cause, and recommended action
Own "the truth" and governance in data and process including the intake, management, automation, and integrity of data sourced from warehouse management systems and downstream data pipelines, so reporting rests on stable, validated data rather than repeated ad hoc extraction from source systems
Champion the data needs and priorities of the SCI team, coordinating with key data/business partners across the Nordstrom organization including DC Operations, Nordstrom Technology, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership
Lead and support data design requirements and delivery for SCI reporting programs and initiatives, including an ongoing legacy-to-modern BI platform migration and a broader shift toward more centralized, self-service analytics
Partner with data engineering to help ensure upstream data is accurate and well-defined, so downstream reporting can rely on consistent logic instead of every analyst re-deriving it independently
Conduct regular audits to ensure data integrity and compliance; monitor and help troubleshoot data pipeline issues, escalating and resolving in partnership with engineering
Shift time from data validation toward analysis: use a more reliable data foundation to prioritize hypothesis testing, trend diagnosis, and forward-looking recommendations over one-off data pulls
Support DC and Supply Chain business partners in the development of modernized reporting and effective analysis, creating compelling narratives and storytelling through data
Support the analysis and diagnosis of end-to-end DC and warehouse performance and provide actionable guidance to improve results
Identify and develop new measures and KPIs that support the continuous improvement and optimization of Nordstrom's supply chain
Collaborate with supply chain and operations teams to identify signals and visibility needed to enhance operations and controls; build reporting to support control monitoring
Leverage AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop to accelerate exploratory analysis and SCI reporting workflows, further shifting analyst time from manual data wrangling to insight generation

You own this if you have…

Degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required (Masters preferred)
5+ years of data management and data analysis; demonstrated ability to technically mentor and support the development of junior analysts
Demonstrated ability to move beyond descriptive reporting to diagnostic and prescriptive analysis — identifying root cause and recommending action, not just surfacing metrics
Strong understanding of ETL processes, data management principles, and data pipeline development using Apache Airflow, Dataflow
Strong understanding of normalized and de-normalized data, data warehousing, query construction, and dimensional data modeling, with applied skills in SQL and hands-on experience with BigQuery
Experience extracting and manipulating large datasets from relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL)
Proficiency in data querying and visualization/reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, IBM Cognos)
Advanced knowledge of version control tools (gitlab/github)
Experience with AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Desktop) to accelerate analysis, automate data workflows, and Looker development preferred
Strong operational business understanding, including potential impact of business decisions on various internal/external stakeholders and systems
Supply chain expertise in retail or consumer goods preferred, with specific focus on warehouse operations, distribution, fulfillment, receiving, or inventory management, and understanding of industry dynamics

Brief Job Description

This position is open to U.S. Citizens and permanent residents.

The Program Specialist V, Project Coordinator provides foundational portfolio and project coordination, oversight documentation, reporting, and compliance support within the IT Customer Experience & Delivery organization, ensuring IT initiatives are managed with high visibility, predictability, quality, and alignment to business goals. The position supports the planning, development, editing, quality assurance, and approval routing of executive-ready oversight deliverables required for project approval and state/federal financial participation and drives timely resolution of questions and issues raised during review cycles. The role serves as an advisor to IT project managers and cross-functional IT enablement partners by translating state/federal oversight expectations into actionable guidance, and by supporting effective project controls, performance monitoring, and risk/issue escalation to strengthen project outcomes across assigned portfolios.

The Project Coordinator supports accurate and consistent project health and performance reporting, including the production of clear executive-level status narratives and the continuous improvement of data quality and portfolio analytics used for decision-making. The position coordinates compliance activities and communications with the State’s Quality Assurance Team (QAT) using the DIR project delivery framework, supports required reporting submissions (including monitoring and quarterly reporting). This role contributes to targeted training and outreach—supported by job aids and tool-focused guidance—to improve stakeholder understanding of oversight requirements, timelines, and quality standards, while improving repeatable processes and technology-enabled solutions that increase efficiency and strengthen governance.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency policy and performs other duties as assigned.

Documentation Development, Quality Control, and Approval Routing (25%)

Supports the end-to-end coordination, development, and submission of project oversight documentation required to obtain and maintain project approval and financial participation from state and federal oversight authorities. This includes gathering and validating input from project teams and stakeholders, drafting/editing documents for completeness, accuracy, and clarity, coordinating internal quality review, routing for approvals, monitoring review status, and supporting the resolution of comments and issues. Reviews documentation packages for quality and submits within required timeframes, while maintaining organized records that support audit readiness, traceability, and continuity across the project lifecycle.

Compliance Reporting and Coordination (20%)

Coordinates with the State’s Quality Assurance Team (QAT) to support compliance with required QAT reporting standards. Participates in discussions with QAT, coordinates responses to questions/issues, ensures required reporting packages are accurate and defensible, and enters project performance information into the SPAR system with attention to detail. Works cross-functionally with project managers, governance partners, and portfolio stakeholders to ensure external reporting aligns to internal project status, and that compliance obligations are met while protecting the agency.

Portfolio Monitoring, Controls Support, and Risk/Issue Escalation (20%)

Performs portfolio-level monitoring of project performance, quality, and risk to promote high-performing projects and predictable delivery outcomes. Reviews project status updates for quality and risk signals, identifies trends or emerging issues, and proactively escalates risks/issues to PMO leadership and appropriate governance channels. Supports project control activities across key lifecycle moments (initiation, corrective actions such as “go-to-green,” changes, and closure) by coordinating required artifacts, recommending corrective actions, and tracking follow-through. Contributes to project performance & reporting functions in governance and cross-coordination forums to ensure risks, decisions, and commitments are visible, documented, and actioned.

Performance Reporting, Data Quality Assurance, and Toolset Subject Matter Expertise (20%)

Ensures project and portfolio reporting is produced efficiently, accurately, and consistently across the assigned portfolio(s). Supports data-quality practices within the project/portfolio management system by performing routine portfolio analysis, validating project health reporting, and influencing project managers to maintain high-quality data through regular engagement. Develops and maintains subject matter expertise in project management toolsets (e.g., PPM, dashboards and reporting platforms such as Power BI, document approval/routing tools, and other emerging technologies) to strengthen reporting reliability and stakeholder transparency. Produces portfolio performance summaries and visualizations that enable leadership decision-making and create consistent understanding of portfolio status.

Project Management Support Services, Proposal/Intake Pipeline Support, and Continuous Improvement (15%)

Provides front-line project performance and coordination services for assigned portfolios by triaging, analyzing, resolving, and responding to project management support requests, and by liaising with IT enablement partners (CTO, BRM, CISO, Application Development, Infrastructure Services, etc.) to influence sound decisions and remove blockers. Supports the coordination, scoping, analysis, and estimation of new IT proposals that form the future project pipeline. Facilitates and documents meetings by capturing notes, action items, and decisions and publishing outcomes to stakeholders. Participates in process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen governance, and leverage automation/AI-enabled solutions where appropriate. Develops and delivers targeted training, job aids, and outreach sessions to project managers and cross-functional IT stakeholders to reinforce oversight expectations, reporting timelines, data-quality standards, and QAT/SPAR compliance requirements across assigned portfolios.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of applicable federal and state laws, rules, policies, and procedures related to IT project oversight and compliance.
Knowledge of portfolio, project, and governance standards, controls, and escalation processes.
Knowledge of project management lifecycles and DIR project delivery framework requirements, including QAT oversight.
